main_text.p: Petrus Martyr: nec {*}Petr.Mart. defens.doctr. Apost.aduer. Gardiner. de Eucharist. part. 1. obiect.13. rem negauit unquam,sed Papisticum rei modum: spiritualiter enim,non corpora-liter, carnaliter, realiter id sumi. Tertium ,prodigij plusquam similè spectrum ab illis introduci, qui corpus Christi in coelo tantum esse verè, & tamen verè in sacra Cæna sumi asserunt. Qua in re si eum non satis coarguat {b}b Loco citato. Poplinerij candor atque eruditio,qui Espencæum taxans,Quasi, inquit, hæc verba, in usu Cæna, & in calo, essent pugnantia: at coarguit Christus, dicens, {e}f Ioh.6.56.Qui comedit corpus meum & bibit sanguinem meum, in me manet, & ego in ipso; at coarguit Paulus, subiungens dicto de {d}d Eph.5.ver.29. Ecclesia, {e}e ver.30.membris corporis Christi, ex carne Christi, ex ossibus Christi, {f}f ver.32.Mysterium hoc magnum est. Nam & {g}g Ioh.19.36.integer Christus, corpore, {h}h Luc.24.39.carne, ossibus, {i}i Act.19. & 31[?].verè est in coelo; & mysterij tamen veritate membra eius sunt in terra, caro ex carne eius, ossa ex ossibus eius, ac ipse[?] in nobis est,& nos in eo: quam vis nec carnaliter eum comedamus, ut {k}k Homer.Odyss.lib.9.Cyclops iocios Vlyssis, {l}l Virg.Aenei.lib.3.Et tepidi tremerent sub dentibus artus; nec ex ossibus eius sic formati simus, ut {m}m Ouid.Metamorphos.lib.6.Pelopis humerus ex ebore, osse elephanti. Iam ad quartum mendacium,parasse Petrum Martyrem in Calvinitas scribere, qui ipsius verba consensu tanto comprobauerant; quid attinet lucernam in luce Solis accendere? Quintum,de venenū a quoquam ei propinati suspicione, refellit fides,probitas, peritia {n}[?]of.Simler. orat. de vit. & obitu Petri Mart.medicorum atque amicorum, qui frequentes seni morbo epidemico laboranti aderant. Sextum,de exhalato infelice spiritu, e nequisimi spiritus sentina exhalatum ostendit {°}•Apoc.14.13. Spiritus ille, cuius verba sunt,Beati mortui qui in Domino moriuntur. page.notes: Left margin reads "f Ioh.6.56." beside the line with the text mark "e" (before "Qui comedit"); the mark letter in the margin is transcribed as printed, so the pairing may be a printing or reading fault. The margin mark "n" beside "Simler" is unclear: the first letter is doubtful. The note for "Act.19." has a doubtful final numeral. "ipse" after "ac" is doubtful. "consensu", "venenū", "ossibus" (printed with a long-s ligature) and "liter" after "corpora-" are read from the scan, and "similè" has a grave accent as printed. Handwritten marks at the lower left and the stain at the foot are excluded.
